findings.title: Threshold condition excludes orders exactly $100
findings.explanation: The acceptance criteria state that orders of $100 or more should ship for free, but the implemented condition uses `total > 100`, which only grants free shipping for totals greater than $100. Orders with a total of exactly $100 will incorrectly be charged the standard shipping fee.

evidence.quote: Orders of $100 or more ship for free.

limitations: The supporting code defining SHIPPING_FEE and any related context was not provided, so we cannot assess whether the constant is correctly defined or imported.
